items.question: How much does a managed website cost?
items.answer: Plans start at $249/month for Lite, $449/month for Business and $749+/month for E-Commerce, billed monthly in USD with no activation fee. See our Pricing page for the full comparison.

items.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
items.answer: No. Every plan is month-to-month with no long-term contract and no activation fee — cancel anytime.

items.question: Who owns the website and domain?
items.answer: You always own your domain, and if you cancel before 3 months you receive all of your own content. After 3 continuous months as a paying subscriber on any plan, you can also take your complete website with you: we transfer it at no charge, with no hidden fees.

items.question: What if I need something updated?
items.answer: Lite includes 10 content updates a month, Business includes 20 and E-Commerce includes 40. Requests beyond your monthly allowance, or larger than a normal update, are quoted separately, or you can move up a plan.

items.question: Can I cancel?
items.answer: Yes — every plan is month-to-month with no long-term contract, so you can cancel anytime. If you cancel before 3 months, you keep your domain and receive all of your own content. After 3 continuous months as a paying subscriber on any plan, you can transfer your complete website to your own hosting at no charge.

items.question: How long does it take to see my preview website?
items.answer: Timelines depend on your business and the information you provide. We confirm an expected timeframe when we review your application.

items.question: Am I guaranteed a free preview?
items.answer: Not automatically. We review every application to make sure we can create something genuinely useful for your business before building a preview.

items.question: How many pages does each plan include?
items.answer: Lite includes up to 5 pages, Business up to 10 and E-Commerce up to 20. Blog posts, legal pages and thank-you pages don't count towards the limit, and E-Commerce product listings are scoped separately when we build your store. Pages beyond your allowance are quoted separately, or you can move up a plan.

items.question: Can I add pages to my website later?
items.answer: Yes. Your plan includes a page allowance — up to 5 pages on Lite, 10 on Business and 20 on E-Commerce — and you can add pages within it at no extra cost. Pages beyond your allowance are quoted separately, or you can move up a plan.

items.question: What counts as a content update?
items.answer: One update is a small change to text, an image or a section on your existing site, usually 20–30 minutes of work. Unused updates don't roll over to the next month. Full custom redesigns and new third-party integrations aren't updates; they are scoped and quoted separately.

items.question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
items.answer: Yes, at any time. We move your site to the new plan's features without rebuilding it from scratch or any downtime.

items.question: What does SynergyFirst Digital do?
items.answer: SynergyFirst Digital helps local businesses improve their online presence through website strategy, web design and development, local SEO, WordPress maintenance, digital marketing and practical automation solutions.

items.question: What types of businesses do you work with?
items.answer: We primarily work with local and service-based businesses, including restaurants, home-service companies, clinics, doctors, financial and professional services, retailers and other businesses that depend on local customers.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside India?
items.answer: Yes. We work remotely with businesses in the USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Germany and other European markets. Our process is designed for clear collaboration across locations and time zones.

items.question: Can you improve an existing website, or do you only build new ones?
items.answer: Both. We can audit and improve an existing website, rebuild an outdated one or create a new digital presence from the ground up. The right approach depends on what is currently limiting performance.

items.question: Do you provide support after the website goes live?
items.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing website care, maintenance and digital support based on what your business needs. You are not left alone after launch.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Book a free 30-minute discovery call. We will discuss your business, current digital presence, immediate priorities and whether SynergyFirst Digital is the right fit for the work.

items.question: Should I book a call or request a free preview?
items.answer: Book a Free 30-Minute Discovery Call if you would like to talk through your goals with us directly. Request a Free Website Preview if you would rather see how your business could look first. If you are unsure, start with the call and we will point you to the right next step.

items.question: Does applying for a free preview guarantee I will get one?
items.answer: No. Submitting an application does not guarantee a preview. We review each application and follow up on the next steps.

items.question: Can you work with me if I am in another time zone?
items.answer: Yes. We work remotely with businesses across the USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and Europe, and the booking tool lets you choose a time in your own time zone.

items.question: How should I prepare for the discovery call?
items.answer: Have your business name, your current website or Google Business Profile (if you have one) and the main problem you want solved to hand. The call is a conversation about fit and priorities, with no obligation.
